subject: Uptime & premium support options for Acme Analytics - proposal & credit matrix
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Diaz <elena.diaz@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Uptime & premium support options for Acme Analytics - proposal & credit matrix

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Per our conversation, attached is a concise set of premium support options structured around uptime tiers, response SLAs, and escalation coverage. High level:

- Standard (included): 99.9% monthly uptime, email support M-F 9–5 PT, standard business-hours escalation. No credits for short interruptions under 30 minutes.
- Premium (paid): 99.95% monthly uptime, P1 response target 1 hour (business hours), 24/7 paging for P1 incidents, 8 credits/month cap.
- Premium Plus (paid): 99.99% monthly uptime, P1 response target 30 minutes, guaranteed 24/7 engineering escalation + quarterly reliability reviews, 12 credits/month cap.

Pricing guidance is in the attached matrix (premium-support-options.pdf) — we list delta per vCPU-hour and a per-seat retainer where applicable. For renewals >24 months we can discuss additional volume discounts.

Two quick notes:
1) Credits are applied as service credits against monthly invoice (see uptime-credit-matrix.xlsx).
2) For audits you can request our SOC2 report (attached).

If you can share the procurement contact and target go-live date, I’ll propose a recommended package and a concise addendum for SOW/DocuSign.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0132

Attachment: premium-support-options.pdf (PDF, 180KB)
Attachment: uptime-credit-matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet, 24KB)

From: Elena Diaz <elena.diaz@acme-analytics.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Uptime & premium support options for Acme Analytics - proposal & credit matrix

On Mon, Jan 12, 2026 at 9:15 AM Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Elena —
> 
> Thanks again for the demo last week. Per our conversation, attached is a concise set of premium support options...

Naomi — thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments. A few clarifying questions from our side before procurement will engage formally:

- We’re aiming for a production SLA close to 99.99% for mission-critical pipelines. Can you confirm the exact credit calculation for Premium Plus in the case of a partial-region outage?
- Pricing: Acme is prepared to commit to a 36-month contract if we can secure a meaningful enterprise discount (Procurement is asking for at least 25% off list for the first two years).
- Escalation: we need phone-based 24/7 escalation for P1 incidents and an assigned escalation engineer during the first 90 days of go-live. Is that standard or an add-on?

CC’ed procurement for visibility. Also please send SOC2 evidence to procurement for their security checklist.

—Elena
Elena Diaz
Head of Platform Engineering | Acme Analytics
elena.diaz@acme-analytics.com

Attachment: none

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Diaz <elena.diaz@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Procurement <procurement@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jan 2026 10:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Uptime & premium support options for Acme Analytics - proposal & credit matrix

Elena — thanks, and great questions. I’ll address them below and loop in Jonas (SE) and Markus (CS) for technical / operational confirmation.

- Partial-region outages: our credit matrix prorates per affected region and per-hour of degraded availability; the spreadsheet shows threshold bands (e.g., 99.99–99.995 = 2 credits, 99.95–99.99 = 6 credits, <99.95 = 12 credits). We can tighten the language for the SOW to call out multi-region calc if you prefer.
- Discount: 25% off list for years 1–2 at 36 months is aggressive but not impossible; I need internal sign-off on margin impact. Can we propose a 15% pilot concession for year 1 with a structured true-up at renewal to reach 20–25% depending on usage commitments?
- Escalation coverage: Premium Plus includes phone-based 24/7 escalation and access to a named escalation engineer for the first 30 days. A named (or dedicated) engineer for 90 days is typically part of an onboarding retainer; Markus can confirm availability and cost.

I’ve attached SOC2 and the credit matrix for procurement. If procurement can share the procurement timelines / PO expectations I’ll prepare a DocuSign bundle (SOW + addendum).

Thanks — Naomi

Attachment: SOC2-report-2025.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)
Attachment: uptime-credit-matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet, 24KB)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Diaz <elena.diaz@acme-analytics.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Procurement <procurement@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jan 2026 15:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Uptime & premium support options for Acme Analytics - proposal & credit matrix

Hi Elena / team — quick technical clarifications on coverage and the named engineer ask:

- Phone-based 24/7 escalation: included in Premium Plus. Pager duty escalation goes to our on-call rotation; we will ensure your P1 phone escalations route to an on-call SRE immediately.
- Named escalation engineer (90 days): we can provide a named escalation engineer as an onboarding add-on. Typical approach: a 0.2 FTE (approx 8 hrs/week) for 90 days billed as a one-time retainer. Approx estimate: $18k–$25k depending on complexity.
- Partial-region calculation: credits are calculated at the region-level then aggregated; if only a single region is affected, charges and credits reflect that region’s impact only. We’ll add explicit examples to the SOW for clarity.

If Acme is comfortable with a 90-day named engineer retainer, we can include that in the DocuSign package as a line item and attach the engineer’s escalation availability schedule.

—Jonas
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0199

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Diaz <elena.diaz@acme-analytics.com>, Procurement <procurement@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 17:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Uptime & premium support options for Acme Analytics - proposal & credit matrix

Elena / Procurement — following internal review and a quick margin check with finance, here’s a firm concession we can offer to move to execution quickly:

- Commercial concession: 15% off list on Premium Plus for year 1, 10% for year 2, with a 36-month term and a usage-based true-up at renewal (targeting 20%+ effective discount if commit volumes are met).
- SLA & credits: We will contractually commit to 99.99% (Premium Plus) with the credit bands as shared. For multi-region wording we’ll add an explicit example in the SOW.
- Escalation & onboarding: include phone-based 24/7 escalation for P1s and provide a named escalation engineer for 90 days as a one-time retainer, included in the price above (no additional retainer).
- Final asks from Acme: a target Go-Live date and PO timeline so we can finalize the SOW and DocuSign package.

If that works I’ll route the SOW + addendum to Procurement via DocuSign (link below) and copy legal for a quick review. Please confirm and I’ll send the package by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks — Naomi
